## Accepted complete theorem and separate oriented strengthening

Halting of nonnegative configurations on finite loopless simple strongly
connected conservative digraphs is NP-complete under polynomial-time
many-one reductions. Target: 3000018 / AMR-029-0018. The separately accepted
appendix proves the same theorem for oriented graphs, with no antiparallel
arcs. In both constructions, deleting the specified root leaves a DAG of
depth at most one, and all initial chip counts, including their total, are
polynomially bounded in the SAT input length. Hardness also holds with unary
chip encoding.

The complete analytic proof preserves the modular-bank identity, Boolean/CRT
clause predicates, actual simple graph construction, legal checkpoint
schedule and least action, every graph/bit/chip bound, fixed trivial cases,
and a self-contained NP membership certificate with the necessary additive
one slack. The appendix preserves its separate three-part oriented graph
construction and directed three-cycle preprocessing. Aggregate finite checks
are supporting metadata only; no omitted executable is needed by the proof.

NP membership and the stable-capacity observation are credited to
Farrell–Levine, CoEulerian graphs, Section 3 and PDF page 2:
https://arxiv.org/abs/1502.04690v3 . Their Section 3.1 poses the simple case,
as does the original attributed Egres question:
https://oldlemon.cs.elte.hu/egres/open/Complexity_of_the_halting_problem_for_simple_digraphs .
This does not resolve Eulerian-multigraph halting and is separate from
multigraph reachability for problem 3000016.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly nine authored proof/appendix/audit/acceptance/status and public-source
review or metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/3000018/`.
Editorial changes reconcile acceptance, use public file names, distinguish
historical supporting observations, and bind the distributed mathematical
files exactly. All analytic arguments, edge cases and qualifications remain.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition makes no first-in-literature or
exhaustive-current-openness claim, and no external human peer-review,
journal-acceptance, or formal proof-assistant-certification claim. Programs,
raw generated outputs, datasets, copied third-party source bodies/PDFs/images,
and private coordination material are excluded. Edition preparation claims
no new scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source inspection, literature
search, or mathematical test rerun.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds
no substantive proof turn and resets no historical accounting. No merge,
release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
